G4400.def:
προ-χειρίζω
(πρόχειρος, at hand) [in LXX: Êx 4:13 (שָׁלַח), Js 3:12 (לָקַח), Dan LXX 3:22, 2Ma.3:7 2Mac 8:9 2Mac 14:12 A * ;]
__1. to put into the hand, deliver up: pass., At 3:20.
__2. More frequently as depon., -ομαι, to take into one's hand; hence, metaphorically, to propose, determine, choose: with inf., At 22:14; with accusative of person(s), At 26:16.†
(AS)

G4401.def:
προ-χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ
(see χειροτονέω)
to choose or appoint beforehand: At 10:41 (Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G4403.def:
πρύμνα, -ης, ἡ
prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, the stern: Mc 4:38, At 27:29; opposite to πρῷρα, At 27:41.†
(AS)

G4404.def:
πρωί (Rec. πρωΐ),
adv. (πρό), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;]
in the morning, early: Mt 16:3 (R, txt.) Mt 21:18, Mc 1:35 11:20 13:35 15:1, Jo 18:28 20:1; λίαν π., Mc 16:2; ἅμα π., Mt 20:1; ἀπὸ π. (cf. ἀπὸ πρωΐθεν, Êx 18:13), At 28:23.†
(AS)

G4405.def:
πρώιος (Rec. -ϊος), -α, -ον
(πρωί), [in LXX for בֹּקֶר בַּ לַּ ;]
at early morn, early; as subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὥρα, cf. ἡ ὥ. ἡ π., 3Ma.5:24), early morning: Mt 27:1, Jo 21:4.†
(AS)

G4406.def:
πρώϊμος, see: πρόϊμος .
πρόϊμος (Rec. πρώ-, of which προ- is a late form; see Bl., § 6, 4; WH, App., 152), -ον,
[in LXX: Dt 11:14 (יוֹרֶה), etc. ;]
= the more common πρώιος (which see),
early: of rain (as most frequently in LXX), Tg 5:7.†
(AS)

G4407.def:
πρωινός
(Rec. -ϊνος, see WH, App., ή, -όν (πρωί), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;]
= cl. πρώιος,
at early morn, early: ἀστήρ, Ap 2:28 22:16.†
(AS)

G4408.def:
πρῷρα (Rec. incorrectly πρώρα, see Bl., § 3, 3; LS, see word), -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, l 2), ἡ,
the forward part of a ship, the prow: At 27:30; opposite to πρύμνα, ib. At 27:41.†
(AS)

G4409.def:
πρωτεύω
(πρῶτος) [in LXX: Et 5:11, 2Ma.6:18 2Mac 13:15 * ;]
to be first, pre-eminent, have the first place: Cl 1:18.†
(AS)

G4410.def:
πρωτοκαθεδρία, -ας, ἡ
(πρῶιος, καθέδρα),
the chief seat: Mt 23:6, Mc 12:39 (see Swete, in l), Lc 11:43 20:46.†
(AS)

G4411.def:
πρωτο-κλυτία, -ας, ἡ
the chief place at table (see Swete, Mk., l.with): Mt 23:6, Mc 12:39, Lc 14:7-8 20:46.†
(AS)

G4413G.def:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Lc 14:18, Jo 19:32, 1Co 14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Ap 1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Hb 10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26, 2Pe 2:20; anarth., Mt 10:2; pl., Mt 19:30, Mc 10:31, Lc 13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co 15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, At 12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 At 27:43, Rm 10:19, 1Tm 1:16, 1Jo 4:19; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. M, Pr., 79; Bl, §11, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 183f.): with genitive, π. μου ἦν (my chief: Abbott, Jg., 509ff.; but cf. M, Pr., 245), Jo 1:15, 30; with art., Mc 14:12, At 1:1, al.; before ὁ δεύτερος, etc., Mt 22:25, Mc 12:20, al.
__2. Of Rank or Dignity, chief, principal: Mt 20:27 22:38, Mc 9:35, Ef 6:2, al.; with genitive, Mc 12:28, 29 al.; πόλις (Field, Notes, 124), At 16:12; with art., Lc 15:22 19:47, At 13:50, al.
__3. Neut., πρῶτον, as adv., first, at the first;
__(a) of Time: Mt 8:21, Mc 4:28, al.; τὸ π., Jo 10:40, al.;
__(b) of Order: Rm 3:2, 1Co 11:18, al.
(AS)

G4413H.def:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Lc 14:18, Jo 19:32, 1Co 14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Ap 1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Hb 10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26, 2Pe 2:20; anarth., Mt 10:2; pl., Mt 19:30, Mc 10:31, Lc 13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co 15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, At 12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 At 27:43, Rm 10:19, 1Tm 1:16, 1Jo 4:19; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. M, Pr., 79; Bl, §11, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 183f.): with genitive, π. μου ἦν (my chief: Abbott, Jg., 509ff.; but cf. M, Pr., 245), Jo 1:15, 30; with art., Mc 14:12, At 1:1, al.; before ὁ δεύτερος, etc., Mt 22:25, Mc 12:20, al.
__2. Of Rank or Dignity, chief, principal: Mt 20:27 22:38, Mc 9:35, Ef 6:2, al.; with genitive, Mc 12:28, 29 al.; πόλις (Field, Notes, 124), At 16:12; with art., Lc 15:22 19:47, At 13:50, al.
__3. Neut., πρῶτον, as adv., first, at the first;
__(a) of Time: Mt 8:21, Mc 4:28, al.; τὸ π., Jo 10:40, al.;
__(b) of Order: Rm 3:2, 1Co 11:18, al.
(AS)

G4413I.def:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Lc 14:18, Jo 19:32, 1Co 14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Ap 1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Hb 10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26, 2Pe 2:20; anarth., Mt 10:2; pl., Mt 19:30, Mc 10:31, Lc 13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co 15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, At 12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 At 27:43, Rm 10:19, 1Tm 1:16, 1Jo 4:19; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. M, Pr., 79; Bl, §11, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 183f.): with genitive, π. μου ἦν (my chief: Abbott, Jg., 509ff.; but cf. M, Pr., 245), Jo 1:15, 30; with art., Mc 14:12, At 1:1, al.; before ὁ δεύτερος, etc., Mt 22:25, Mc 12:20, al.
__2. Of Rank or Dignity, chief, principal: Mt 20:27 22:38, Mc 9:35, Ef 6:2, al.; with genitive, Mc 12:28, 29 al.; πόλις (Field, Notes, 124), At 16:12; with art., Lc 15:22 19:47, At 13:50, al.
__3. Neut., πρῶτον, as adv., first, at the first;
__(a) of Time: Mt 8:21, Mc 4:28, al.; τὸ π., Jo 10:40, al.;
__(b) of Order: Rm 3:2, 1Co 11:18, al.
(AS)

G4413J.def:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Lc 14:18, Jo 19:32, 1Co 14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Ap 1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Hb 10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26, 2Pe 2:20; anarth., Mt 10:2; pl., Mt 19:30, Mc 10:31, Lc 13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co 15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, At 12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 At 27:43, Rm 10:19, 1Tm 1:16, 1Jo 4:19; = πρότερος (see infr.; cf. M, Pr., 79; Bl, §11, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 183f.): with genitive, π. μου ἦν (my chief: Abbott, Jg., 509ff.; but cf. M, Pr., 245), Jo 1:15, 30; with art., Mc 14:12, At 1:1, al.; before ὁ δεύτερος, etc., Mt 22:25, Mc 12:20, al.
__2. Of Rank or Dignity, chief, principal: Mt 20:27 22:38, Mc 9:35, Ef 6:2, al.; with genitive, Mc 12:28, 29 al.; πόλις (Field, Notes, 124), At 16:12; with art., Lc 15:22 19:47, At 13:50, al.
__3. Neut., πρῶτον, as adv., first, at the first;
__(a) of Time: Mt 8:21, Mc 4:28, al.; τὸ π., Jo 10:40, al.;
__(b) of Order: Rm 3:2, 1Co 11:18, al.
(AS)

G4414.def:
πρωτοστάτης, -ου, ὁ
(πρῶτος, ἵστημι) [in LXX: Jó 15:24 AB * ;]
prop., of soldiers, one who stands first, one in the front rank (Thuc., Xen.); hence, metaphorically, a leader: At 24:5.†
(AS)

G4415.def:
πρωτοτόκια, -ων, τά
(πρωτότοκος) [in LXX (with seel. -εῖα, -εία): Gn 25:31 ff. Gn 27:36, Dt 21:17, 1Cr 5:1 (בְּכוֹרָה) * ;]
the rights of the first-born, birthright (= cl. ἡ πρεσβεία): Hb 12:16.†
(AS)

G4416.def:
πρωτότοκος, -ον
(πρῶτος, τίκτω) [in LXX chiefly for בְּכוֹר ;]
first-born: Lc 2:7; pl., Hb 11:28. Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ (originally perh. a Messianic title, cf. Sl 89:28, Hb 1:6; see ICC on Cl 1:15): Hb 1:6; π. πάσης κτίσεως, Cl 1:15; ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, Rm 8:29; π. (ἐκ) τ. νεκρῶν, Cl 1:18, Ap 1:5; pl., of the elect, ἐκκλησία πρωτοτόκων, Hb 12:23.†
(AS)

G4417.def:
πταίω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַף ni. ;]
__1. trans., to cause to stumble (1Rs 4:3, cf. Deiss., BS, 681).
__2. Intrans., to stumble. Metaphorical, in moral sense, Rm 11:11, Tg 2:10 3:2, 2Pe 1:10.†
(AS)

G4418.def:
πτέρνα, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for עָקֵב ;]
the heel: figuratively, ἐπαίρειν τὴν π. ἐπί, Jo 13:18 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4419.def:
πτερύγιον, -ου, -τό
(dimin. of πτέρυξ), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
__1. a little wing.
__2. Anything like a wing, as a turret, battlement: τ. ἱεροῦ, Mt 4:5, Lc 4:9.†
(AS)

G4420.def:
πτέρυξ, -υγος, ἡ
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
a wing: of birds, Mt 23:37, Lc 13:34, Ap 12:14; of creatures seen in a vision, Ap 4:8 9:9.†
(AS)

G4422.def:
πτοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for חָתַת ni. ;]
to terrify. Pass., to be terrified: Lc 21:9 24:37 (WH, mg., θροηθέντες).†
(AS)

G4423.def:
πτόησις, -εως, ἡ
(πτοέω) [in LXX: Pv 3:25 (פַּחַד), Sir 50:4 א1, 1Ma.3:25 R * ;]
a fluttering, excitement, caused by any emotion, but esp. by fear, hence, terror: φοβεῖσθαι πτόησιν, to be afraid with (cogn. accusative) or of any terror (see ICC, in l): 1Pe 3:6.†
(AS)

G4424.def:
Πτολεμαΐς, -ΐδος, ἡ
Ptolemais, a maritime city of Phœnicea: At 21:7.†
(AS)

G4425.def:
πτύον, -ου, τό
[in Sm.: Is 30:24 * ;]
a winnowing shovel or fan: Mt 3:12, Lc 3:17.†
(AS)

G4426.def:
πτύρομαι depon.,
to be startled, frightened: Fp 1:28. (The active πτύρω is also found in some late writers.) †
(AS)

G4428.def:
πτύσσω
to fold; of a scroll, to roll up: βιβλίον, Lc 4:20 (cf. ἀνα-πτύσσω).†
(AS)

G4429.def:
πτύω
[in LXX: Nm 12:14 (יָרָק), Sir.28:12 * ;]
to spit: Mc 7:33 8:23, Jo 9:6 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐμ-πτύω).†
(AS)

G4430.def:
πτῶμα -τος, τό
(πίπτω), [in LXX: Jz 14:8 (מַפֶּלֶת), Jó 16:15 (14) (פֶּרֶץ), Is 51:19 (שֹׁד), Jdth.8:19, Wis.4:18, al. ;]
__1. a fall, metaphorically, a misfortune, calamity (Trag., Plat., Polyb., al.; LXX).
__2. That which has fallen;
__(a) of buildings, a ruin (Polyb.);
__(b) of living creatures, in cl. (poët. only) usually with genitive, νεκρῶν, etc., but also absol., as in late writers and NT, a fallen body, a carcase, corpse: Mt 14:12 24:28, Mc 15:45; π. αὐτοῦ, Mc 6:29; αὐτῶν, Ap 11:8-9 (cf. Rutherford, NPhr., 472 f.).†
(AS)

G4431.def:
πτῶσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίπτω), [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶף, מַפֶּלֶת, and cogn. forms ;]
a falling, fall (Plat., Plut., al.): Mt 7:27; metaphorically, Lc 2:34.†
(AS)

G4432.def:
πτωχεία, -ας, ἡ
(πτωχεύω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
beggary, destitution: 2Co 8:2 8:9, Ap 2:9.†
(AS)

G4433.def:
πτωχεύω
(πτωχός), [in LXX: Jz 6:6, Sl 79:8 (דָּלַל); Jz 14:15 A, Pv 23:21 (יָרַשׁ); Sl 34:10 (רוּשׁ), Tob.4:21 * ;]
__1. to be a beggar, to beg (so chiefly in cl.).
__2. to be poor as a beggar, to be destitute, poor: opposite to πλούσιος ὤν, 2Co 8:9.†
(AS)

G4434.def:
πτωχός, -ή, -όν
(πτώσσω, to crouch, cower), [in LXX for עָנִי, דַּל, רָשׁ, etc. ;]
of one who crouches and cowers, hence,
__1. as subst., a beggar: Lc 14:13, 21 16:20, 22.
__2. As adj.,
__(a) prop., beggarly: metaphorically, στοιχεῖα, Gl 4:9 (see Lft., in l);
__(b) in broader sense (opposite to πλούσιος), poor: Mt 11:5 19:21 26:9, 11, Mc 10:21 12:42-43 14:5, 7, Lc 4:18 7:22 18:22 19:8 21:3, Jo 12:5-6, 8 13:29, Rm 15:26, 2Co 6:10, Gl 2:10, Tg 2:2-3, 6, Ap 13:16; π. τ. κόσμῳ, Tg 2:5; metaphorically, Lc 6:20, Ap 3:17; π. τ. πνεύματι, Mt 5:3.†
SYN.: πένης, q.v (AS)

G4435.def:
πυγμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Êx 21:18, Is 58:4 (אֶגְרֹף) * ;]
the fist: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χῖρας (Τ, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), to wash the hands with the fist (diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; see Swete, in l): Mc 7:3.†
(AS)

G4436.def:
πύθων, -ωνος, ὁ
__1. in cl., Python, a serpent slain by Apollo, who is hence surnamed the Pythian.
__2. In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. Lv 19:31 20:6, 27, 1Rs 28:7), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, a python-spirit: At 16:16.†
(AS)

G4437.def:
πυκιός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Eze.31:3 A (חֹרֶשׁ), 3Ma.1:28 3Mac 4:10, 4Ma.12:12 * ;]
__1. close, compact, solid.
__2. frequent: 1Tm 5:23. Neut. pl., πυκνά, as adv., much, often: Mc 7:3 Τ (see: πυγμή), Lc 5:33. Comparat., πυκνότερον, very often or so much the oftener (seeBl., § 44, 3,): At 24:26.†
(AS)

G4439.def:
πύλη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח ;]
a gate: Lc 7:12, At 9:24 12:10 16:13, Hb 13:12; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, At 3:10. Metaphorical, Mt 7:13-14; πύλαι ᾅδου (Wis.16:13, 3Ma.5:51, and cf. κλαῖς ᾅδου Ap 1:18): Mt 16:18.†
(AS)

G4440.def:
πυλών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(πύλη), [in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, שַׁעַר ;]
__1. the porch or vestibule of a house or palace: Mt 26:71, Lc 16:20, At 10:17 12:13-14
__2. The gate-way or gate-tower of a walled town: At 14:13, Ap 21:12-13, 15 21:21, 25 22:14.†
(AS)

G4441.def:
πυνθώ᾽ομαι
[in LXX for דָּרַשׁ ;]
__1. to inquire: with accusative of thing(s), Jo 4:42, At 23:20; before quæst. indir., Mt 2:4, Lc 15:25 18:36, At 10:18 21:33; quæst. dir., At 4:7 10:20 23:10; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), Mt 2:4, Jo 4:52.
__2. to learn by inquiry: before ὅτι, At 23:34.†
(AS)

G4442.def:
πῦρ genitive, πυρός, τό,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for אֵשׁ ;]
fire: Mc 9:22, Lc 3:9, Jo 15:6, At 2:10, 1Co 3:13, Tg 3:5, Ap 8:5, al; π. καὶ θεῖον, Lc 17:29; κατακαίειν (ἐν) π., Mt 13:40, Ap 17:16 18:8; καίεσθαι πυρί, Hb 12:18, Ap 8:8 21:8; φλὸξ πυρός, At 7:30, 2Ts 1:8, Hb 1:7, Ap 1:14 2:18 19:12; λαμπάδες πυρός, Ap 4:5; στῦλοι πυρός, Ap 10:1; ἄνθρακες πυρός, Rm 12:20 (LXX); γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, At 2:3; δοκιμάζειν (πυροῦσθαι) διὰ πυρός, 1Pe 1:7, Ap 3:18; ὡς διὰ. π. (Lft., Notes, 193), 1Co 3:15. Of the fire of hell (cf. Dalman, Words,161): Mc 9:48 (LXX); τὸ π. τὸ αἰώνιον, Mt 18:8 25:41 (cf. 4Ma.12:12); ἄσβεστον, Mc 9:43; πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχειν, Ju 7; γέεννα τοῦ π., Mt 5:22 18:9; κάμινος τοῦ π., Mt 13:42, 50; ἡ λίμνη τοῦ π., Ap 19:20 20:10, 14-15; πυρὶ τηρεῖσθαι, 2Pe 3:7; βασανισθῆναι ἐν π., Ap 14:10. Metaphorical: βαπτίζειν πυρί, Lc 3:16; of the tongue, Tg 3:5; of strife and discord, Lc 12:49; ἐκ π. ἁρπάζειν, Ju 23; πυρὶ αλίζεσθαι, Mc 9:49; ζῆλος πυρός, Hb 10:27; of God, π, καταναλίσκον, Hb 12:29 (LXX)
(AS)

G4443.def:
πυρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(πῦρ) [in LXX: Jdth.7:5, Wis.17:6, al. ;]
a fire: At 28:2-3.†
(AS)

G4444.def:
πύργος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִגְדָּל ;]
a tower: Lc 13:4; of a watch-tower in a vineyard (Is 5:2): Mt 21:33, Mc 12:1, and prob., Lc 14:28.†
(AS)

G4445.def:
πυρέσσω
(πῦρ)
to be ill of a fever: Mt 8:14, Mc 1:3.†
(AS)

G4446.def:
πυρετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(πῦρ) [in LXX: Dt 28:22 (קַדַּחַת) * ;]
a fever: Mt 8:15, Mc 1:31, Lc 4:39, Jo 4:52, At 28:8; π. μέγας, a high fever: Lc 4:38 (on the technical phrase here, see MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4448.def:
πυρόω, -ῶ
(πῦρ) [in LXX chiefly for צָרַף ;]
to set on fire, burn up. In NT always pass.,
__1. to be set on fire, to burn: Ef 6:16, 2Pe 3:12; ptcp., glowing, Ap 1:15. Metaphorical, of grief or indignation, 2Co 11:29; of lust, 1Co 7:9.
__2. Of metals (cf. Jó 22:25, Sl 12:7, Zc 13:9), to be refined or purified by fire: Ap 3:18 (and so in RV, Ap 1:15, but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4449.def:
πυρράζω
(πυρρός), [in LXX, πυρρίζω: Lv 13:19, 42 ff. Lv 14:37 (אֲדַמְדָּם) * ;]
to be fiery red: Mt 16:2-3.†
(AS)

G4450.def:
πυρρός -ά, -όν
(πῦρ) [in LXX for אֱדֹם ;]
fiery red: Ap 6:4 12:3.†
Πύρρος, -ου, ὁ,
Pyrrhus: At 20:4.†
(AS)

G4451.def:
πύρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(πυρόω), [in LXX: Pv 27:21 (כּוּר), Am 4:9 (שְׁדֵפָה) * ;]
__1. a burning: Ap 18:9, 18.
__2. a refining or trial by fire: metaphorically, 1Pe 4:12.†
(AS)

G4453.def:
πωλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ;]
__1. to exchange or barter.
__2. to sell: Lc 17:28, Ap 13:17; οἱ πωλοῦντες, Mt 21:12 25:9, Mc 11:15, Lc 19:45; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 13:44 19:21 21:12, Mc 10:21 11:15, Lc 12:33 18:22 22:36, Jo 2:14, 16 At 5:1 (sc. αὐτά, αὐτόν), At 4:34, 37. Pass., 1Co 10:25; with genitive pretii, Mt 10:29, Lc 12:6.†
(AS)

G4454.def:
πῶλος, -ου, ὁ
(in cl. also ) [in LXX chiefly for עַיִר ;]
a foal, colt, prop., of a horse, then the young of other animals; in NT of the colt of an ass: Mt 21:2, 5" (LXX), Mt 21:7, Mc 11:2, 4-5 11:7, Lc 19:30, 33 19:35, Jo 12:15" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4456.def:
πωρόω, -ῶ
(πῶρος, 1. a stone. 2. a callus) [in LXX: Jó 17:7 B(כָּהָה), Pv 10:20 A * ;]
to petrify, harden, form a callus. Metaphorical, π. τ. καρδίαν, Jo 12:40. Pass., Rm 11:7; τ. νοήματα, 2Co 3:14; ἡ καρδία, Mc 6:52 8:17 †
(AS)

G4457.def:
πώρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(πωρόω),
a covering with a callus, a hardening: metaphorically, Mc 3:6, Rm 11:2, Ef 4:18.†
(AS)

G4458.def:
πως,
enclit. part.,
at all; see: εἴπως, μήπως.
μήπως
or μή πως (so WH),
negative particle,
__1. as conjc., lest haply: in final sentences, 1Co 9:27, 2Co 2:7 9:4; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, 1Co 8:9, 2Co 11:3 12:20, Gl 4:11; with an ellipse of ptcp. (sc. φοβούμενος; cf. B1., § 65, 3; Burton, § 225), 1Ts 3:5 (but see infr.).
__2. As interrogative, whether haply: Gl 2:2, 1Ts 3:5 (cf. M, Th., in l, but see supr.).†
μήπου
(WH, μή που),
lest anywhere, lest haply: At 27:29.†
(AS)

G4459.def:
πῶς, interrog. adv., correl. of ὅπως,
__1. prop., in direct questions, how?: with indic., Mt 12:29, Mc 3:23, Lc 11:18, Jo 3:4, al.; καὶ π., Mc 4:13, Lc 20:44; π. οὖν, Mt 12:26; π. οὐ, Mt 16:11, Lc 12:56; in deliberative questions (cf. Bl., §64, 6), with subjc., Mt 23:33 26:54; π. οὖν, Rm 10:14; π. δέ, Rm 10:14, 15; before ἄν, with optative, At 8:31.
__2. As sometimes in cl. but more frequently and increasingly so in late writers (see WM, §57, 2; Bl., §70, 2; Thumb, MGr., 192; Jannaris, Gr., App., vi, 13f.), = ὅπως, ὥς;
__(a) in indirect discourse: with indic., Mt 6:28, Mc 12:41, Lc 8:36, Jo 9:15, At 9:27, al.; with subjc., Mc 11:18, Lc 12:11;
__(b) in exclamations: Mt 21:20, Mc 10:23, 24 Lc 12:50 18:24, Jo 11:36.
(AS)

G4460.def:
Ῥαάβ
(and Ραχάβ, Mt 1:5; Ραχάβη, -ης, in FlJ), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. רָחָב)
Rahab (LXX, Js 2:1, al.): Hb 11:31, Tg 2:25.†
(AS)

G4461.def:
ῥαββεί (Rec. -βί, see WH, App., 155) (Heb. and Aram. רַב, my master; see Dalman, Words, 327, 331 ff.),
a title of respectful address to Jewish teachers, Rabbi: Mt 23:7-8; of John, Jo 3:26; of Christ, Mt 26:25, 49, Mc 9:5 11:21 14:45, Jo 1:30, 50 3:2 4:31 6:25 9:2 11:8; κύριε ῥ Mc 10:51 (WH, mg., see: ῥαββουνεί).†
ῥαββουνεί (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, Words, 324, 340; Gr., 140; DB, iv, 190)
Rabboni: Mc 10:51 (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), Jo 20:16.†
(AS)

G4462.def:
ῥαββουνεί (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, Words, 324, 340; Gr., 140; DB, iv, 190)
Rabboni: Mc 10:51 (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), Jo 20:16.†
(AS)

G4463.def:
ῥαβδίζω
(ῥάβδος), [in LXX: Jz 6:11 Rt 2:17 (חָבַט) * ;]
to beat with a rod: At 16:22, 2Co 11:25.†
(AS)

G4464.def:
ῥάβδος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מַטֶּה (e.g. Gn 47:31, MT, מַטֶּה, bed), also for מַקֵּל, שֵׁבֶט, etc. ;]
a staff, rod: Hb 9:4, Ap 11:1; in particular,
__(a) a staff, such as is used on a journey: Mt 10:10, Mc 6:8, Lc 9:3, Hb 11:21" (LXX) ;
__(b) a ruler's staff, a sceptre: Hb 1:8 (LXX) Ap 2:27 12:5 19:15;
__(with) a rod for chastisement (cf. ῥαβδίζω): ἐν ῥ. (see: ἐν): 1Co 4:21.†
(AS)

G4465.def:
ῥαβδοῦχος, -ου, ό
(ῥαβδος, ἔχω),
one who carries a rod or staff of office;
__(a) an umpire or judge (Plat.);
__(b) in late writers, a Roman lictor: At 16:38.†
(AS)

G4466.def:
Ῥαγαύ (Rec. -αῦ), ὁ, indecl. (LXX for Heb. רְעוּ, Gn 11:18, al.),
Reu: Lc 3:35.†
(AS)

G4467.def:
ῥᾳδιούργημα, -τος, τό
(ῥᾳδιουργέω, to act recklessly or wrongly)
__1. a reckless act.
__2. crime, villany: At 18:14.†
(AS)

G4468.def:
ῥᾳδιουργία, -ας, ἡ
(see: ῥᾳδιούργημα),
__1. ease in doing, facility (Xen.).
__2. easiness, laziness (Xen.).
__3. recklessness, wickedness (of lewdness, Xen.; fraud, Plut.; in π., of theft, MM, xxii): At 13:10.†
(AS)

G4469.def:
ῥακά (T, ῥαχά),
usually taken to represent the Aram. רֵיקָא, a shortened form of H7386, " empty," as vocalized in the Galilæan dialect; an expression of contempt, raca: Mt 5:22 (cf. DB, iv, 191 f.; and for other explanations, see Zorell, see word).†
(AS)

G4470.def:
ῥάκος, -ους, τό
[in LXX: Is 64:6 (5) (בֶּגֶד), Jr 38:11 (סְחָבָה), Et 4:17 * ;]
__1. a ragged garment (Hom.).
__2. a rag, remnant, piece of cloth: Mt 9:16, Mc 2:21.†
(AS)

G4472.def:
ῥαντίζω
[in LXX: Lv 6:27 (20), 4Ki.9:33 (נָזָה), Sl 51:7 (חָטָא pi.) * ;]
= cl., ῥαίνω,
to sprinkle, besprinkle: with accusative, Hb 9:13, 19; id. and dative, Hb 9:21; pass., Ap 19:13, WH; of cleansing by sprinkling, Hb 10:22 (see M, Gr., ii, 100); mid., Mc 7:4 (WH, txt., R, mg.).†
περι-ραίνω
(-ρραίνω, Rec., see WH, App., 139 f.), [in LXX for נָזָה hi. ;]
to sprinkle around: Ap 19:13 T (ῤεραντισμένον, WH; ῤε-, R, txt.; βεβαμμένον, Rec., R, mg.).†
(AS)

G4473.def:
ῥαντισμός, -ῦo, ὁ
(ῥαντίζω), [in LXX for נִדָּה ;]
sprinkling: of the ceremonial sprinkling of blood for purification, Hb 12:24, 1Pe 1:2 (see Hort, Pe., 23 ff.).†
(AS)

G4474.def:
ῥαπίζω
(ῥαπίς, a rod), [in LXX: Jz 16:25, Hb 11:4, I Et 4:11 * ;]
__1. prop., to strike with a rod.
__2. In late writers, to strike (the face) with the palm of the hand: Mt 26:67; with accusative of person(s), before εἰς τ. σιαγόνα, Mt 5:39 (cf. Field, Notes, 40, 105).†
(AS)

G4475.def: a stroke, a slap on the face , (Lucian) (ML)

G4476.def:
ῥαφίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(ῥάπτω, to sew),
a needle: Mt 19:24, Mc 10:25 (cf. βελόνη).†
(AS)

G4477.def:
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Js 2:1;
mother of: Boaz (H1162)(?)
§ Rahab, "spacious, broad"
Rachab, (Proper name), indeclinable, Mt. 1:5*

G4480.def:
ῥέδη (see WH, App., 151), -ης, ἡ
(a Gallic word),
a chariot: Ap 18:13.†
(AS)

G4481.def:
Ῥεμφάν, Ῥεφάς, see: Ῥομφά.
Ῥομφά (-άν, T; Ῥεφάν, LTr.; Ῥεμφάν, Rec.; see WH, App., 92),
[in LXX: Am 5:26 (Ῥαιμφάν or Ῥεφάν, Heb. כִּיּוּן)* ;]
Rompha, Rephan (RV), one of the names of Seb, the Egyptian Saturn: At 7:43 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4482.def:
ῥέω
[in LXX chiefly for זוּב ;]
to flow: Jo 7:38 (cf. παραρρέω).†
(AS)

G4483.def:
λέγω,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Gn 22:16, al. ;]
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., At 13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Mt 9:34, Mc 3:11, Jo 1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Mc 3:21, Lc 1:24, Jo 6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Lc 11:18, Jo 12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Mt 11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Mt 25:9, Mc 3:33, 7:28, Lc 24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Mt 3:9, Lc 3:8, al.; of writing, 2Co 8:8, Fp 4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, Rm 4:3, Tg 2:23, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 8:8, 9:33, Jo 5:34, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), Mt 27:11, Mc 15:2, Lc 23:3, Jo 18:37; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., Mt 8:20, Mc 2:17, al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, Mt 3:9, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., Mc 4:41, Jo 11:56, Hb 9:5, al.; to mean (cl.), Mc 14:71, Jo 6:71, 1Co 10:29, al.; to call, name, Mc 10:18; pass., Mt 9:9, Mc 15:7, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G4484.def:
Ῥήγιον, -ου, τό
Rhegium, a town in Sicily: At 28:13.†
(AS)

G4485.def:
ῥῆγμα, -τος, τό
(ῥήγνυμι), [in LXX: 3Ki.11:30-31 12:24, 4Ki.2:12 (קֶרַע), Am 6:12 (11) A (בְּקִיעַ) * ;]
__1. cl. (and so in LXX), a fracture; then by meton., that which is torn.
__2. In NT, ruin: Lc 6:49.†
(AS)

G4486.def:
ῥήγνυμι and (Mc 9:18) ῥήσσω,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע, also for קָרַע, etc. ;]
__1. to rend, break asunder: Mt 7:6, Mc 2:22, Lc 5:37; pass., Mt 9:17.
__2. Of the voice, with accusative, φωνήν, etc. (Hdt., al.), to break forth into speech: absol., Gl 4:27 (LXX).
__3. = ῥήσσω (Dem., al.), to throw or dash down: Mc 9:18, Lc 9:42
(cf. δια-, περι-, προσ-ρήγνυμι).†
SYN.: θραύω, κατάγνυμι (AS)

G4487.def:
ῥῆμα, -τος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, also for פֶּה, and Aram. פִּתְגָּם, etc. ;]
__1. prop., of that which is said or spoken,
__(a) a word: Mt 27:14, 2Co 12:4; pl., τὰ ῥ., of speech, discourse, Lc 7:1, Jo 8:20, At 2:14, Rm 10:18, 2Pe 3:2, al.;
__(b) opposite to ὄνομα (a single word), a saying, statement, word of prophecy, instruction or command (in cl., phrase): Mt 26:75, Mc 9:32, Lc 1:38 2:50, At 11:16, Rm 10:8, Hb 11:3; ῥ. θεοῦ (κυρίου), Lc 3:2, At 11:16, Ef 6:17, Hb 6:5 11:3, 1Pe 1:25" (LXX) ; τὰ ῥ. τ. θεοῦ, Jo 3:34 8:47; ῥ. ἀργόν, Mt 12:36;ῥ. ἄρρητα, 2Co 12:4.
__2. Like Heb. דָּבָר (but perh. also a Gk. colloquialism, see Kennedy, Sources, 124; Thackeray, Gr., 41), of that which is the subject of speech, a thing, matter (Gn 15:1, Dt 17:8, al.): Lc 1:37 2:15, At 10:37; pl., Lc 1:65 2:19, 51, At 5:32 13:42
(AS)

G4489.def:
ῥήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
a public speaker, an orator: At 24:1.†
(AS)

G4491.def:
ῥίζα, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַשׁ ;]
a root: Mt 3:10, Lc 3:9; ἐκ ῥιζῶν, Mc 11:20; ῥ. ἔχειν, Mt 13:6, Mc 4:6; id. before ἐν ἑαυτῷ, figuratively, Mt 13:21, Mc 4:17, Lc 8:13. Metaphorical (as in various senses in cl.), of cause, origin, source, etc.;
__(a) of things, ῥ. πάντων τ. κακῶν (Eur.), 1Tm 6:10;
__(b) of persons: of ancestors, Rm 11:16-18; ῥ. πικρίας, Hb 12:15. Of that which springs from a root, a shoot; metaphorically, of offspring, Rm 15:12 (LXX) Ap 5:5 22:16.†
(AS)

G4492.def:
ῥιζόω, -ῶ
(ῥίζα), [in LXX: Is 40:24, Jr 12:2 (שָׁרַשׁ), Sir.3:28 24:12 * ;]
to cause to take root. Metaphorical, to plant, fix firmly, establish: pass. (EV, rooted), ἐν ἀγάπῃ, Ef 3:18(17); ἐν Χριστῷ, Cl 2:7 (cf. ἐκ ριζόω).†
(AS)

G4493.def:
ῥιπή, ῆς, ἡ
(ῥίπτω),
poët. in cl., any rapid movement such as the throw or flight of a javelin, the rush of wind or flame, the flapping of wings, the twinkling of lights; ῥ. ὀφθαλμοῦ, the twinkling of an eye: 1Co 15:52 (L, mg., ῥοπή, which see).†
(AS)

G4494.def:
ῥιπίζω
(ῥιπίς, a fan) [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:35 (נְשָׂא) * ;]
primarily, to fan a fire, hence generally, to make a breeze (Plut., al.). In pass. (cf. Philo, de inter. round., 24), to be tossed or blown by the wind: of waves, ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ, blown and raised with the wind (Hort, in l), Tg 1:6.†
(AS)

G4496.def:
ῥίπτω and (At 22:23) ῥιπτέω (strengthened form; see Veitch, see word ῥίπτω, fin.),
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
__1. to throw, cast, hurl: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 27:5, At 27:19, 29; with accusative of person(s), Mt 15:30, Lc 4:35; pass., Lc 17:2; ptcp., ἐριμμένοι, cast down, prostrate (Polyb., al.): Mt 9:36; of garments, to throw off (for flight, Eur., Xen., al.; ὅπλα, 1Ma.5:43; so EV in At 22:23, but see infr.).
__2. = ῥιπτάζω, to shake, toss, throw about: τ. ἱμάτια, At 22:23 (EGT, Page, Rackham, in l; Field, Notes, 136; but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4499.def: the isle of Rhodes , (Iliad by Homer), etc. (ML)
